headline: DPC Holdings Receives Upgrade From Moody’s to Ba2 Outlook Upgraded to Positive
summary: ST HELIER, Jersey, July 31, 2026--DPC Holdings (NYSE: DPC) ("Doncasters") reported on July 30, 2026, that Moody’s upgraded the corporate family rating (CFR) of Alloy Parent Limited (Doncasters) three notches to Ba2 from B2 and changed the outlook to positive from stable.
